{
  "decisions": [
    {"decision_id":"471ac40d91cc179e7be7-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 範例以 `>` 覆寫檔案，未保留既有日誌內容。","evidence":"bash -p -c 'echo DATA >/path/to/output-file'"},
    {"decision_id":"ce4c4bc25e5157435f58-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 的 Bash 檔案讀取範例會輸出指定本機檔案的內容。","evidence":"bash -p -c 'echo \"$(</path/to/input-file)\"'"},
    {"decision_id":"ee8b44604c7b5f3f2065-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例以 `>` 覆寫目標，未示範保留原內容的追加。","evidence":"bash -c 'echo DATA >/path/to/output-file' Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"11b3a56517f3575b62a0-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一下載範例涵蓋 sudo，並明載可用覆寫選項將下載內容寫入指定檔案。","evidence":"Download This executable can download remote data. Comment Use --allow-overwrite if needed."},
    {"decision_id":"15aecf9afabef5f9f15f-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"這是讀檔範例；換行出現在讀取輸出，未追加至既有檔案。","evidence":"File read This executable can read data from local files. Comment A newline is appended to the file."},
    {"decision_id":"2c83add72e7df1895702-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例讀取指定檔案，未將所選資料追加寫回。","evidence":"comm /path/to/input-file /dev/null Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"303ad6de2aaa0f5b82c1-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"範例僅讀檔並在輸出加上換行，未向日誌追加指定文字。","evidence":"File read This executable can read data from local files. Comment A newline is appended to the file."},
    {"decision_id":"85462a1e23b5ab3c8d9a-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 範例的功能是讀取，沒有把文字寫到本機檔案末尾。","evidence":"comm /path/to/input-file /dev/null Remarks The content is corrupted or otherwise altered by the process"},
    {"decision_id":"c6381c87d091d91e376b-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 範例只讀取本機檔案，未追加所選文字至既有日誌。","evidence":"File read This executable can read data from local files."},
    {"decision_id":"d0824172f525e697f016-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"一般使用者範例讀取指定檔案，沒有寫入選定文字。","evidence":"Unprivileged This function can be performed by any unprivileged user. comm /path/to/input-file /dev/null"},
    {"decision_id":"d2333a5fae7b04722f3d-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"來源是 GTFOBins，且段落示範讀檔，未提供 sudo 追加。","evidence":".. / comm File read File read This executable can read data from local files."},
    {"decision_id":"14286f5f7d37dda4ee0e-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一 Screen 寫檔範例明載追加行為，且提供 sudo 情境。","evidence":"screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA Sudo This function is performed by the privileged user if executed via sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"3641238bda7371ae25f9-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"Screen 有追加日誌的範例，但此段只涵蓋一般使用者與 sudo，未涵蓋 SUID。","evidence":"screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"51dc611ef637344a44df-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"一般使用者可用 Screen 將選定文字追加至指定檔案。","evidence":"Unprivileged This function can be performed by any unprivileged user. screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA"},
    {"decision_id":"76cdc61940e66c7e41f5-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Screen 的 sudo 寫檔範例會將選定文字加到本機檔案末尾。","evidence":"screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA Sudo This function is performed by the privileged user if executed via sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"858b3a66b8e0fbd01f43-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"段落明載資料追加至本機檔案，保留原內容；換行會轉換格式。","evidence":"File write This executable can write data to local files. Version requirements 4.06.02 Comment Data is appended to the file and \\n is converted to \\r\\n ."},
    {"decision_id":"8d5ad5de0d55b9a21d92-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"雖有 sudo 追加範例，來源仍是 GTFOBins，不符合外部來源條件。","evidence":"screen | GTFOBins"},
    {"decision_id":"8d9393a4a71490f0c1ad-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Screen 的檔案寫入範例明載追加，且同一範例適用於 sudo。","evidence":"screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA Sudo This function is performed by the privileged user if executed via sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"c1b73fe72a7bd0456012-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Screen 的 sudo 範例將選定文字追加至指定的本機日誌。","evidence":"screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"eaf4f30281533ffa7d29-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一 sudo 範例會把實際文字追加寫入所選檔案，保留原內容。","evidence":"screen -L -Logfile /path/to/output-file echo DATA Sudo This function is performed by the privileged user if executed via sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"1ff593c75eea46d34481-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 讀檔範例解析指定檔案，並透過錯誤訊息顯示內容。","evidence":"SUID This function is performed by the privileged user if the executable has the SUID bit set and the right ownership because the effective privileges are not dropped. bc -s /path/to/input-file quit"},
    {"decision_id":"94443d016b9ae50c260f-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 範例使用 Alpine 在終端介面顯示指定檔案的內容。","evidence":"File read This executable can read data from local files. Comment The file is displayed in the terminal interface."},
    {"decision_id":"18e539f6418c86c2f504-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 讀檔範例利用錯誤訊息取出指定檔案的逐行內容。","evidence":"Comment Each line of the file is interpreted as a path and the content is leaked via error messages."},
    {"decision_id":"207d3fc37bbd79ec6cc1-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Hashcat 的同一 sudo 寫檔範例明載會追加至輸出檔末尾。","evidence":"Comment Append data to the end of the output file, creating if does not exist."},
    {"decision_id":"251d5b12e52cc765b9a0-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"追加寫檔範例提供一般使用者與 sudo 情境，未記載 SUID。","evidence":"--outfile-autohex-disable /path/to/hash /path/to/wordlist Sudo This function is performed by the privileged user if executed via sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"3f84f423e66543f1abcc-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一 sudo 範例以選定資料產生輸出，並明載將其追加至目標檔案。","evidence":"File write This executable can write data to local files. Comment Append data to the end of the output file, creating if does not exist."},
    {"decision_id":"6250d948d5d50eb64c7f-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Hashcat 的 sudo 範例可把選定文字追加到指定輸出檔，該路徑可指向本機日誌。","evidence":"hashcat -m 0 --quiet --potfile-disable -o /path/to/output-file --outfile-format=2 --outfile-autohex-disable /path/to/hash /path/to/wordlist Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"68ccf1a882419ee5bb70-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"範例明載資料會寫到輸出檔末尾，既有內容得以保留。","evidence":"Comment Append data to the end of the output file, creating if does not exist."},
    {"decision_id":"84277022f122da5ff393-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一追加寫入範例提供 sudo 版本，並允許指定本機輸出路徑。","evidence":"hashcat -m 0 --quiet --potfile-disable -o /path/to/output-file --outfile-format=2 --outfile-autohex-disable /path/to/hash /path/to/wordlist Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"9c72b6810717490c1dac-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Hashcat 的 sudo 寫檔範例採追加方式，可保留既有檔案內容。","evidence":"Comment Append data to the end of the output file, creating if does not exist."},
    {"decision_id":"cb50c4a3b84c3eae818a-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一寫檔範例支援 sudo，可將選定內容寫到指定本機路徑。","evidence":"hashcat -m 0 --quiet --potfile-disable -o /path/to/output-file --outfile-format=2 --outfile-autohex-disable /path/to/hash /path/to/wordlist Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"e6fe181dbf8da9ccc67d-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"追加寫檔的同一範例明載一般使用者可執行，並可指定資料。","evidence":"Comment Append data to the end of the output file, creating if does not exist. Unprivileged This function can be performed by any unprivileged user."},
    {"decision_id":"eda04e31029fa7601414-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"雖有 sudo 追加寫檔內容，來源是 GTFOBins，未符合來源限制。","evidence":"hashcat | GTFOBins"},
    {"decision_id":"ae678dd3ded24da5272f-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例讀取並解碼檔案，未寫入內容來覆蓋本機檔案。","evidence":"base58 /path/to/input-file | base58 --decode Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"ef026465f21340b0567d-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 範例修改檔案權限，未將任何選定文字追加至檔案。","evidence":"chmod 6777 /path/to/input-file"},
    {"decision_id":"a6df8e103fc1a82eb567-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例使用 mawk 將指定文字寫入選定本機檔案。","evidence":"mawk 'BEGIN { print \"DATA\" > \"/path/to/output-file\" }' Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"fd93e69d05fde804b74a-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例以 `>` 覆寫，未示範保留原內容的追加。","evidence":"mawk 'BEGIN { print \"DATA\" > \"/path/to/output-file\" }' Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"fe242f08a893a68bc932-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"SUID 範例以 `>` 覆寫指定檔案，未在末尾追加。","evidence":"mawk 'BEGIN { print \"DATA\" > \"/path/to/output-file\" }' File read"},
    {"decision_id":"1422fe25b98b96876833-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"同一讀檔範例明列 SUID 情境，會輸出指定本機文字檔的內容。","evidence":"column /path/to/input-file SUID This function is performed by the privileged user if the executable has the SUID bit set and the right ownership"},
    {"decision_id":"2f6834bb6f5ea9467605-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"medium","reason":"sudo 範例以 `-O` 將指定輸入內容寫到本機輸出檔，作為替換內容的寫入。","evidence":"check_log -F /path/to/input-file -O /path/to/output-file Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"3912813b6786f63a6f19-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 範例指定輸出檔寫入，但未記載保留舊內容的追加方式。","evidence":"check_log -F /path/to/input-file -O /path/to/output-file Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"5b45798c2e9e4beb26b3-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"段落示範把輸入內容寫至輸出檔，未記載向既有日誌追加文字。","evidence":"check_log -F /path/to/input-file -O /path/to/output-file Sudo"},
    {"decision_id":"992b5c261b661f791d5d-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"sudo 寫檔範例會將選定輸入檔的內容寫到指定本機路徑。","evidence":"check_log -F /path/to/input-file -O /path/to/output-file Sudo This function is performed by the privileged user if executed via sudo"}
  ]
}
